ex.en: Please bring a warm coat when you visit.
ex.zh: 你来时请带一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Improved public transport can bring significant benefits to residents who cannot afford their own cars.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通能为买不起私家车的居民带来显著益处。

ext.tip: bring强调带到说话者或指定地点；过去式brought。
senses: to carry someone or something to a place
to cause a situation, feeling, or result

ex.en: We built a small wooden shelter in the garden.
ex.zh: 我们在花园里搭了一个小木棚。

ex.en: Local authorities should build more affordable homes near public transport to support families on low incomes.
ex.zh: 地方政府应在公共交通设施附近建造更多经济适用住房，以帮助低收入家庭。

ext.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为built；体格可用build。
senses: to make structures or develop something over time
the size and shape of a person's body

ex.en: I need to buy some bread before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我需要在吃早饭前买些面包。

ex.en: Consumers can reduce packaging waste when they buy fresh produce from local markets.
ex.zh: 消费者在当地市场购买新鲜农产品时，可以减少包装废弃物。

ext.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bought；不要写成buyed。
senses: to obtain something by paying money for it
to believe an explanation or accept an idea
买到的东西；合算的购买
something bought, especially something offering good value

ex.en: I'll call you when I get home tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚到家后我会给你打电话。

ex.en: Environmental groups call for stricter regulations to reduce plastic waste entering rivers and oceans.
ex.zh: 环保团体呼吁制定更严格的法规，减少流入河流和海洋的塑料垃圾。

ext.tip: call sb表示给某人打电话，不加to。
senses: To telephone someone or shout to get their attention.
To give someone or something a particular name.
A telephone conversation or a public request for action.

ex.en: Could you carry this heavy bag upstairs for me?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这个沉重的袋子拿上楼吗？

ext.tip: carry强调携带或搬运；bring和take还体现方向。
senses: Hold or support something while moving it somewhere
Have something with you wherever you go
Contain and potentially pass on a disease or infection

ex.en: We changed our plans when the rain started falling.
ex.zh: 开始下雨时，我们改变了计划。

ex.en: Governments should change transport policies to encourage cycling and reduce dependence on private cars in cities.
ex.zh: 政府应调整交通政策，鼓励骑行并减少城市居民对私家车的依赖。

ext.tip: 表示“零钱、找零”时不可数，不能说a change。
senses: to become different, replace something, or exchange money
an instance or process of becoming different
coins, or money returned when you pay more than the price

ex.en: I dropped my keys while reaching for my phone.
ex.zh: 我伸手拿手机时，钥匙掉了。

ex.en: If public transport becomes more reliable, the number of people driving to work may drop significantly.
ex.zh: 如果公共交通变得更可靠，开车上班的人数可能会显著下降。

ext.tip: drop by表示下降了多少；drop to表示降至多少。
senses: to fall, let something fall, or become lower
a very small, rounded amount of liquid
to stop doing or considering something

ex.en: Please feed the cat before you leave for school.
ex.zh: 请在上学前喂一下猫。

ex.en: School meal programmes help feed children whose families cannot consistently afford nutritious food.
ex.zh: 学校供餐计划帮助那些家庭无法持续负担营养食物的儿童吃上饭。

ext.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为fed；feed on表示以……为食。
senses: Give food to someone or an animal, or eat food.
A regularly updated stream of online content.

ex.en: My neighbour helped me fix the broken kitchen tap.
ex.zh: 邻居帮我修好了厨房里坏掉的水龙头。

ex.en: Governments should fix weaknesses in existing transport networks before investing in expensive new infrastructure.
ex.zh: 政府应先解决现有交通网络的薄弱环节，再投资昂贵的新基础设施。

ext.tip: fix既可修理物品，也可解决问题或确定日期。
senses: Make something work properly or solve a problem.
Attach something firmly in a particular place.
Decide an exact time, price, or arrangement.

ex.en: We grow fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房窗边的花盆里种新鲜香草。

ex.en: As cities grow, local authorities must invest in transport systems that serve expanding populations.
ex.zh: 随着城市发展，地方政府必须投资建设满足不断增长的人口需求的交通系统。

ext.tip: 过去式grew，过去分词grown；表变得后接形容词。
senses: To become bigger or develop over time.
To raise plants for food or other purposes.
To gradually become different in condition or feeling.

ex.en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这些袋子提上楼吗？

ex.en: Affordable public transport can help residents access jobs and reduce their dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会，并减少他们对汽车的依赖。

ext.tip: help后接动词原形或to不定式均可。
senses: Make something easier or better for someone.
Support that makes a difficulty or task easier.

ex.en: We hid the birthday present under the bed.
ex.zh: 我们把生日礼物藏在了床底下。

ex.en: Companies should not hide information about environmental risks associated with their products or manufacturing processes.
ex.zh: 企业不应隐瞒其产品或生产流程所涉及的环境风险信息。

ext.tip: 过去式hid，过去分词hidden；hide from意为躲避。
senses: To put or stay somewhere out of sight.
To prevent others from knowing or noticing something.
The skin of a large animal, often used for leather.

ex.en: My ankle still hurts when I climb the stairs.
ex.zh: 我上楼梯时，脚踝还是疼。

ex.en: Cuts to public transport funding may hurt rural communities that depend on buses for essential journeys.
ex.zh: 削减公共交通经费可能损害依赖公交出行办理必要事务的农村社区的利益。

ext.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为 hurt；疼痛部位可作主语。
senses: To feel pain or cause physical injury.
To cause emotional pain or damage something.

ex.en: Let's invite our new neighbours over for dinner.
ex.zh: 我们邀请新邻居过来吃晚饭吧。

ex.en: Local councils should invite residents to discuss proposed changes before making decisions about public spaces.
ex.zh: 地方议会在就公共空间作出决定前，应邀请居民讨论拟议的改动。

ext.tip: invite sb to＋活动；invite sb to do＋动作。
senses: to ask someone to attend something or do something
to request a response or make a reaction likely

ex.en: The baby's funny dance made everyone laugh at dinner.
ex.zh: 宝宝滑稽的舞蹈让吃晚饭的每个人都笑了。

ex.en: People who laugh together regularly may develop stronger social bonds and cope better with everyday stress.
ex.zh: 经常一起欢笑的人可能建立更牢固的社会联系，并更好地应对日常压力。

ext.tip: laugh at人常指嘲笑；laugh with人指一起笑。
senses: To make sounds showing amusement or happiness.
The sound or act of expressing amusement.

ex.en: I always lose my keys inside this enormous bag.
ex.zh: 我总是在这个大包里找不到钥匙。

ex.en: Small businesses may lose customers when major retailers offer similar products at significantly lower prices.
ex.zh: 大型零售商以低得多的价格提供类似产品时，小企业可能会流失顾客。

ext.tip: 过去式和过去分词都是lost；别与loose混淆。
senses: to become unable to find something you had
to stop having something or have less of it
to fail to win a game or competition

ex.en: I didn't mean to leave you waiting outside.
ex.zh: 我不是故意让你在外面等着的。

ex.en: Higher energy prices may mean that low-income households have less money available for other essential needs.
ex.zh: 能源价格上涨可能意味着低收入家庭可用于其他基本需求的钱会更少。

ext.tip: mean to do是“打算做”；mean doing是“意味着做”。
senses: to express, involve, or intend something
unkind or unwilling to share or spend money
the total of several values divided by how many exist

ex.en: Could you move this chair closer to the window?
ex.zh: 你能把这把椅子挪到靠窗一点的位置吗？

ex.en: The decision to expand public transport is a positive move towards reducing urban congestion.
ex.zh: 扩大公共交通的决定是缓解城市拥堵的一项积极举措。

ext.tip: moving指令人感动的，moved指感到感动的。
senses: To change position or go to live somewhere else.
To make someone feel a strong emotion.
An action taken to achieve a particular result.

ex.en: You must wear a helmet when riding here.
ex.zh: 在这里骑车必须戴头盔。

ex.en: Governments must ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 政府必须确保所有儿童都能接受优质教育，不论其家庭收入如何。

ext.tip: must是情态动词；mustn't表禁止，不是“不必”。
senses: used to express a strong obligation or requirement
used to express a confident conclusion

ex.en: These plants need more water during hot weather.
ex.zh: 天气炎热时，这些植物需要更多的水。

ex.en: Cities need to improve public transport if they want to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市若想减少人们对私家车的依赖，就需要改善公共交通。

ext.tip: need to do表需要做；need doing表需要被做。
senses: To require something because it is necessary or important
Something necessary or the condition of requiring it
A situation in which essential things are lacking

ex.en: You can pick any colour for your new curtains.
ex.zh: 新窗帘的颜色你可以随便选。

ex.en: Schools should help students pick courses that match their interests rather than focus only on future earnings.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生选择符合兴趣的课程，而不是只关注未来收入。

ext.tip: pick可指挑选或采摘；捡起通常用pick up。
senses: to choose someone or something from available options
to remove fruit or flowers from a plant
a tool with a pointed metal head for breaking hard ground

ex.en: Please send me a photo of your new puppy.
ex.zh: 请发一张你家新养的小狗的照片给我。

ex.en: Governments should send medical teams to isolated communities that lack access to basic healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应向缺乏基本医疗服务的偏远社区派遣医疗队。

ext.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sent；可用send sth to sb。
senses: To make something go or be delivered to another place.
To arrange for someone to go somewhere.

ex.en: Shall we take a short walk after dinner?
ex.zh: 我们晚饭后去散一会儿步好吗？

ex.en: Under the proposed regulations, employers shall provide appropriate safety equipment for all workers handling hazardous materials.
ex.zh: 根据拟议规定，雇主必须为所有接触危险材料的工人提供适当的安全装备。

ext.tip: 情态动词，后接动词原形；Shall we常用于提议。
senses: Used with I or we to offer or suggest something.
Used with I or we to express future intentions formally.
Used in formal rules to state a requirement.

ex.en: Take an umbrella because it might rain this afternoon.
ex.zh: 带把伞吧，今天下午可能会下雨。

ex.en: Developing reliable public transport networks takes considerable time and requires sustained investment from local authorities.
ex.zh: 建设可靠的公共交通网络需要相当长的时间，也需要地方政府持续投入资金。

ext.tip: 过去式took，过去分词taken；take带走，bring带来。
senses: To pick up, hold, or carry something away.
To require a particular amount of time or effort.
To use a particular form of transport.

ex.en: I think this soup needs a little more salt.
ex.zh: 我觉得这汤需要再加一点盐。

ex.en: Some people think that schools should devote more time to practical skills rather than examination preparation.
ex.zh: 一些人认为，学校应将更多时间用于实用技能，而不是备考。

ext.tip: 过去式、过去分词均为thought；认为时通常不用进行时。
senses: To have an opinion or belief about something.
To use your mind to consider ideas or solve problems.

ex.en: We usually travel by train to visit our grandparents.
ex.zh: 我们通常坐火车去看望祖父母。

ex.en: Affordable public transport enables residents to travel more sustainably and reduces dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 价格合理的公共交通让居民能够以更可持续的方式出行，并减少对私家车的依赖。

ext.tip: 泛指旅行时travel不可数；一次旅行用a trip。
senses: To go from one place to another.
The activity of going to other places.
To move or spread from one place to another.

ex.en: Please wait here while I find my keys.
ex.zh: 请在这里等一下，我去找钥匙。

ex.en: Patients in rural areas often wait longer for specialist treatment because local medical services are limited.
ex.zh: 由于当地医疗服务有限，农村地区的患者往往需要等待更久才能接受专科治疗。

ext.tip: 等人用wait for someone；等着做用wait to do。
senses: To let time pass until something happens or someone arrives.
To be left until a later time.
A period spent expecting something to happen.

ex.en: Please wake me before you leave for work.
ex.zh: 请在你出门上班前叫醒我。

ex.en: People who wake at consistent times may find it easier to maintain healthy sleep patterns.
ex.zh: 在固定时间醒来的人可能更容易保持健康的睡眠规律。

ext.tip: 过去式woke，过去分词woken；常与up连用。
senses: to stop sleeping, or make someone stop sleeping
the disturbed water left behind a moving boat

ex.en: The lion rested beneath a tree in the shade.
ex.zh: 那头狮子在树荫下休息。

ex.en: Protecting lions requires large habitats where they can hunt naturally without coming into conflict with farmers.
ex.zh: 保护狮子需要大片栖息地，让它们能够自然捕猎而不与农民发生冲突。

ext.tip: 狮群用a pride of lions；母狮称lioness。
senses: A large wild cat, whose males usually have thick neck hair.

ex.en: Protecting panda habitats also benefits other species that depend on the same mountain forests for survival.
ex.zh: 保护大熊猫栖息地也有益于其他依赖同一片山林生存的物种。

ext.tip: panda通常指大熊猫；red panda指小熊猫。
senses: a large black and white bear native to China

ex.en: A white rabbit hopped across the grass towards us.
ex.zh: 一只白兔蹦蹦跳跳地穿过草地，朝我们跑来。

ex.en: Introducing rabbits into new environments can damage native vegetation and disrupt the balance of local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 将兔子引入新环境可能破坏原生植被，扰乱当地生态系统的平衡。

ext.tip: rabbit泛指兔；hare通常指腿耳更长的野兔。
senses: a small animal with long ears, soft fur, and strong back legs

ex.en: My back feels stiff after sitting all morning.
ex.zh: 坐了一上午后，我感觉背部僵硬。

ex.en: Local residents are likely to back transport projects that reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 当地居民很可能支持能缓解拥堵并方便就业出行的交通项目。

ext.tip: go back表示回去；back作动词可表示支持。
senses: The rear part of your body or of something else.
Towards the rear, or to a previous place or state.
To support a person, plan, or organization.

ex.en: We took turns choosing games to keep things fair.
ex.zh: 我们轮流选游戏，以保证公平。

ex.en: A fair education system should give every child access to quality teaching, regardless of family income.
ex.zh: 公平的教育制度应让每个孩子都能获得优质教学，不受家庭收入影响。

ext.tip: fair指待遇公平；fairly还可表示“相当”。
senses: having pale skin or light hair
an event where people display or sell goods and services

ex.en: Let the soup cool, then remove the fat.
ex.zh: 让汤凉下来，再撇去油脂。

ex.en: Although the body needs some fat, excessive consumption can increase the risk of certain health problems.
ex.zh: 虽然人体需要一定的脂肪，但摄入过多会增加某些健康问题的风险。

ext.tip: 用fat形容人可能冒犯；谈健康宜用overweight。
senses: a substance stored in bodies or used in cooking
having a large amount of body fat

ex.en: He wrapped a warm scarf around his neck.
ex.zh: 他在脖子上围了一条暖和的围巾。

ex.en: Office workers may experience neck pain if their computer screens are positioned at an unsuitable height.
ex.zh: 如果电脑屏幕的高度不合适，办公室职员可能会感到颈部疼痛。

ext.tip: neck指脖子；throat指喉咙，勿混用。
senses: the body part connecting the head to the shoulders
a narrow part of an object, such as a bottle

ex.en: My stomach started rumbling while I was cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 我做晚饭时，肚子开始咕咕叫。

ex.en: Eating regular meals may help prevent stomach discomfort and support healthy eating habits among students.
ex.zh: 规律进餐可能有助于预防胃部不适，并帮助学生养成健康的饮食习惯。

ext.tip: 表示“忍受”时，常用于 can't stomach 结构。
senses: The organ that digests food, or the surrounding body area
To accept something unpleasant without feeling upset or disgusted

ex.en: I wore a thin jacket and felt cold outside.
ex.zh: 我穿了件薄外套，在外面觉得冷。

ex.en: Thin layers of insulation can improve energy efficiency without significantly reducing the usable space inside buildings.
ex.zh: 薄层隔热材料能提高能源效率，同时不会明显减少建筑内部的可用空间。

ext.tip: 形容身材时，thin不一定褒义；slim通常含赞美。
senses: Having little distance between opposite sides or surfaces.
Having little body fat or flesh.
To make or become less dense, thick, or numerous.

ex.en: Hang your wet coat by the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 把你的湿外套挂在厨房门边。

ex.en: Applying a protective coat to metal structures can reduce maintenance costs and extend their useful life.
ex.zh: 给金属结构涂上保护层可以降低维护成本，延长其使用寿命。

ext.tip: 动词常用coat A with B，意为给A涂上B。
senses: an outer garment worn for warmth or protection
a layer of paint or another covering substance
cover a surface with a layer of something

ex.en: The puppy was afraid of the noisy vacuum cleaner.
ex.zh: 那只小狗害怕吵闹的吸尘器。

ex.en: Some employees are afraid to report workplace problems because they worry about losing their jobs.
ex.zh: 有些员工不敢反映职场问题，因为他们担心失去工作。

ext.tip: 通常作表语，不放名词前；用afraid of或afraid to do。
senses: feeling fear or worry about something
used to introduce unwelcome information politely

ex.en: All the children brought fruit for the picnic.
ex.zh: 所有孩子都带了水果来野餐。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to affordable healthcare, regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有公民无论收入如何，都能获得负担得起的医疗服务。

ext.tip: all可接复数或不可数名词；every接单数可数名词。
senses: the whole amount of something or every member of a group
everything or everyone in a particular group

ex.en: The baby was asleep before we reached home.
ex.zh: 我们还没到家，宝宝就睡着了。

ex.en: People who use electronic devices late at night may find it harder to fall asleep.
ex.zh: 深夜使用电子设备的人可能更难入睡。

ext.tip: asleep通常作表语；“熟睡的婴儿”用a sleeping baby。

ex.en: The soup tasted so bad that I stopped eating.
ex.zh: 这汤太难喝了，我便不再喝了。

ex.en: Bad air quality can discourage outdoor exercise and increase health risks among children and older adults.
ex.zh: 空气质量差会使人减少户外锻炼，并增加儿童和老年人的健康风险。

ext.tip: 比较级worse，最高级worst；badly是副词。
senses: Not good in quality or not satisfactory.
Serious, unpleasant, or likely to cause harm.
Behaving wrongly or breaking accepted rules.

ex.en: This bakery makes the best bread in our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 这家面包店做的面包是我们街区最好的。

ex.en: Investing in early education may be the best way to reduce inequality over time.
ex.zh: 投资早期教育可能是逐步减少不平等的最佳方式。

ext.tip: best是good和well的最高级；形容词前通常加the。
senses: Better than all others in quality or suitability.
In the most successful way or to the greatest degree.
The finest performance, effort, or thing available.

ex.en: This backpack is better than my old one.
ex.zh: 这个背包比我原来的那个好。

ext.tip: 是good和well的比较级，不说more better。
senses: Of higher quality or more suitable than something else.
In a more effective or satisfactory way.

ex.en: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
ex.zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我都睡着了。

ex.en: Students may find repetitive exercises boring unless teachers explain their purpose and introduce variety.
ex.zh: 如果教师不解释练习的目的并增加变化，学生可能会觉得重复练习很乏味。

ext.tip: boring指令人无聊；bored指人感到无聊。

ex.en: My keys were at the bottom of my bag.
ex.zh: 我的钥匙在包的最底下。

ex.en: Waste often collects at the bottom of rivers, damaging habitats and threatening aquatic life.
ex.zh: 废弃物经常堆积在河底，破坏栖息地并威胁水生生物。

ext.tip: 在某物底部用at the bottom of。
senses: The part of your body that you sit on.

ex.en: You were brave to speak in front of everyone.
ex.zh: 你敢在大家面前发言，真勇敢。

ex.en: It takes brave leadership to introduce necessary environmental reforms when powerful groups strongly oppose them.
ex.zh: 当强势群体激烈反对时，推行必要的环境改革需要勇敢的领导力。

ext.tip: brave并非毫不害怕，而是害怕仍敢面对。
senses: Willing to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.
To face something dangerous or unpleasant with courage.

ex.en: Your brilliant idea saved us hours of work.
ex.zh: 你的绝妙主意为我们省下了好几个小时的工作。

ex.en: Brilliant teachers can inspire students to explore difficult subjects with confidence and genuine curiosity.
ex.zh: 出色的教师能激励学生带着信心和真正的好奇心探索难学的科目。

ext.tip: 英式口语中常用 brilliant 表示“太棒了”。
senses: Shining brightly or having a strong, vivid colour.

ex.en: I am busy making soup for dinner right now.
ex.zh: 我现在正忙着做晚餐要喝的汤。

ex.en: Busy urban roads can discourage cycling unless local authorities provide safe routes separated from motor traffic.
ex.zh: 繁忙的城市道路可能让人不愿骑车，除非地方政府提供与机动车流隔离的安全路线。

ext.tip: 用busy doing或busy with，不用busy to do。
senses: Having many things to do or being actively occupied.
Full of people, traffic, or activity.
Already being used, especially a telephone line.

ex.en: Be careful with that bowl; it belonged to Grandma.
ex.zh: 小心拿那个碗，那是奶奶以前用的。

ex.en: Careful planning can help cities expand public transport while keeping construction costs under control.
ex.zh: 周密的规划可以帮助城市扩展公共交通，同时控制建设成本。

ext.tip: be careful with后接物；be careful to后接动词。
senses: taking care to avoid danger, damage, or mistakes

ex.en: That cute kitten is sleeping inside my slipper.
ex.zh: 那只可爱的小猫正睡在我的拖鞋里。

ex.en: Advertisements often feature cute animals to attract attention and create positive feelings towards a product.
ex.zh: 广告常用可爱的动物吸引注意，让人们对产品产生好感。

ext.tip: 偏口语，常形容婴儿、小动物或讨喜的外表。
senses: Attractive in a sweet or charming way.

ex.en: That broken step is dangerous, so please avoid it.
ex.zh: 那级破损的台阶很危险，请避开它。

ex.en: Poorly maintained roads can create dangerous conditions for cyclists, especially during heavy rain or after dark.
ex.zh: 维护不善的道路会给骑行者带来危险，尤其是在大雨中或天黑后。

ext.tip: dangerous是形容词；修饰动作要用dangerously。
senses: Likely to cause harm, injury, or serious problems.

ex.en: These gloves look similar, but their sizes are different.
ex.zh: 这些手套看起来相似，但尺码不同。

ex.en: Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.
ex.zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生能为课堂上的全球议题讨论提供宝贵的视角。

ext.tip: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。
senses: not the same as someone or something else
used to describe several separate people, things, or types

ex.en: This heavy suitcase is difficult to carry upstairs.
ex.zh: 这个沉重的行李箱很难搬上楼。

ext.tip: 常用find it difficult to do，勿把difficulty当形容词。
senses: Needing considerable effort or skill to do or understand.
Not easy to please, manage, or deal with.

ex.en: The towels are dry after hanging in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 毛巾在阳光下晾过后已经干了。

ex.en: Long periods of dry weather can damage crops and threaten food security in agricultural communities.
ex.zh: 长期干旱天气会损害农作物，并威胁农业社区的粮食安全。

ext.tip: 形容词比较级drier；名词dryer指烘干设备。
senses: not wet or containing very little moisture
to remove moisture or become free from moisture

ex.en: This soup is easy to make with fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 用新鲜蔬菜做这道汤很容易。

ex.en: Providing easy access to reliable health information can help people make better decisions about their lifestyles.
ex.zh: 让人们方便地获取可靠的健康信息，有助于他们作出更好的生活方式选择。

ext.tip: 常用easy to do；修饰动作通常用easily。
senses: Not difficult and requiring little effort.
Relaxed and free from worry or pressure.

ex.en: The final minutes of the match were incredibly exciting.
ex.zh: 比赛最后几分钟精彩刺激极了。

ex.en: Advances in renewable energy offer exciting opportunities for young engineers seeking to address global environmental challenges.
ex.zh: 可再生能源的进步为希望应对全球环境挑战的年轻工程师提供了令人振奋的机会。

ext.tip: exciting形容令人兴奋的事物；excited形容人的感受。
senses: Making someone feel eager, enthusiastic, or thrilled.

ex.en: This village is famous for its delicious apple pies.
ex.zh: 这个村庄以美味的苹果派闻名。

ex.en: Famous landmarks attract international visitors, but tourism revenue should also support the communities surrounding them.
ex.zh: 著名地标吸引着国际游客，但旅游收入也应惠及周边社区。

ext.tip: famous for接出名的原因，famous as接身份。

ex.en: Be careful; the soup is still very hot.
ex.zh: 小心，汤还很烫。

ex.en: As summers become increasingly hot, cities need more shaded public spaces to protect residents from heat.
ex.zh: 随着夏季越来越炎热，城市需要更多有遮阴设施的公共空间来保护居民免受高温影响。

ext.tip: 形容食物时可指“烫”或“辣”，需结合语境。
senses: Having a strong taste that burns your mouth.
Attracting a lot of interest or discussion.

ex.en: A huge dog was sleeping beside the tiny kitten.
ex.zh: 一只大狗正睡在那只小猫旁边。

ex.en: Investing in public transport could bring huge benefits to cities struggling with congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 对于饱受交通拥堵和空气污染困扰的城市，投资公共交通可以带来巨大益处。

ext.tip: 本身表示极大，常用absolutely huge加强语气。
senses: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: I caught the last bus home just before midnight.
ex.zh: 我在午夜前刚好赶上了回家的末班车。

ex.en: Products that last longer can reduce household spending and limit the amount of waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 更耐用的产品可以减少家庭开支，并减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物量。

ext.tip: last week指上周；the last week可指最后一周。
senses: Final in a sequence, or most recent before the present.
To continue for a period or remain usable.
After everyone else, or on the most recent previous occasion.

ex.en: Warm light came through the curtains into our bedroom.
ex.zh: 温暖的光线透过窗帘照进了我们的卧室。

ex.en: Access to natural light in classrooms may improve students' concentration and reduce electricity consumption.
ex.zh: 让自然光进入教室可能有助于提高学生的专注力，并减少用电量。

ext.tip: 光线通常不可数；一盏灯用a light；动词过去式常用lit。
senses: brightness that enables sight, or a device producing it
not heavy, bright, or pale in colour
make something burn or provide brightness

ex.en: A little bird landed on our kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟落在我们厨房的窗台上。

ex.en: Many rural schools have little access to digital resources, which can widen existing educational inequalities.
ex.zh: 许多农村学校很难获得数字资源，这可能加剧现有的教育不平等。

ext.tip: little加不可数名词表示几乎没有；a little表示有一点。
senses: Small in size or young in age.
Not much; almost no amount of something.
Only slightly or not very much.

ex.en: We got lost while walking through the old town.
ex.zh: 我们在老城区步行时迷路了。

ex.en: Without clear guidance, new university students may feel lost when choosing courses that affect their future careers.
ex.zh: 缺少明确指导时，大学新生在选择影响未来职业的课程时可能会感到迷茫。

ext.tip: get lost可指迷路；单独用作命令语气粗鲁。
senses: Unable to find the way, or unable to be found.
Unable to understand something or decide what to do.
Past tense and past participle of lose.

ex.en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
ex.zh: 在我们的新公寓里，我终于有了自己的房间。

ex.en: People who own their homes may feel more financially secure, although maintenance costs can be substantial.
ex.zh: 拥有住房的人可能在经济上更有安全感，不过房屋维护费用也可能相当高。

ext.tip: own表“自己的”前通常有物主词，如my own。
senses: Belonging to a particular person, rather than someone else.
To have something that legally belongs to you.

ex.en: We found a pretty cottage beside a quiet stream.
ex.zh: 我们在一条安静的小溪边发现了一座漂亮的小屋。

ex.en: Although pretty public gardens attract visitors, cities must also ensure that these spaces remain accessible to residents.
ex.zh: 虽然漂亮的公共花园能吸引游客，但城市也必须确保居民能方便地使用这些空间。

ext.tip: 作副词表示“相当”时偏口语，正式写作可用fairly。
senses: Attractive and pleasant to look at.
To a fairly large degree, especially in informal speech.

ex.en: Her quick reaction stopped the glass from falling.
ex.zh: 她反应敏捷，及时接住了差点掉落的玻璃杯。

ex.en: A quick response to reports of water pollution can prevent serious damage to nearby ecosystems.
ex.zh: 对水污染报告作出迅速回应，可以防止附近生态系统遭受严重破坏。

ext.tip: 正式表达中用副词quickly修饰动作。
senses: moving or acting fast, without much delay

ex.en: The house was quiet after the children fell asleep.
ex.zh: 孩子们睡着后，屋子里安静了下来。

ex.en: Quiet study spaces in public libraries are essential for students who cannot concentrate at home.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆内安静的学习空间对无法在家集中注意力的学生至关重要。

ext.tip: quiet是“安静的”，quite是“相当”，注意拼写。
senses: a state with little or no noise

ex.en: Dinner is ready, so please bring your plate.
ex.zh: 晚饭好了，请把你的盘子拿来。

ex.en: Schools must ensure that students are ready to meet the demands of a rapidly changing workplace.
ex.zh: 学校必须确保学生做好准备，以应对快速变化的职场需求。

ext.tip: ready for后接名词；ready to后接动词原形。
senses: Prepared or available for use or action.
About to do something very soon.

ex.en: We placed a round table beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房窗边放了一张圆桌。

ex.en: A further round of negotiations may help governments reach an agreement on reducing industrial emissions.
ex.zh: 新一轮谈判可能有助于各国政府就减少工业排放达成协议。

ext.tip: round作介词常见于英式英语，美式多用around。
senses: shaped like a circle or ball
one stage in a repeated series of activities
around something or on all sides of it

ex.en: Your bike is safe inside our locked garage.
ex.zh: 你的自行车放在我们锁好的车库里很安全。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all communities have access to safe drinking water and reliable sanitation.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有社区都能获得安全饮用水和可靠的卫生设施。

senses: Protected from danger or unlikely to cause harm.
Unlikely to fail or lead to loss.
A strong locked container for money and valuable objects.

ex.en: We took a slow walk along the river.
ex.zh: 我们沿着河边慢慢散步。

ex.en: Slow progress in expanding public transport may discourage commuters from giving up their private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通扩建进展缓慢，可能会削弱通勤者放弃私家车的意愿。

ext.tip: slow多作形容词；修饰一般动作通常用slowly。
senses: Moving, happening, or taking place at a low speed.
To move or happen less quickly, or make something do so.
Showing a time earlier than the correct time.

ex.en: My brother is strong enough to lift this sofa.
ex.zh: 我哥哥力气很大，能抬起这张沙发。

ex.en: There is strong evidence that regular physical activity improves both mental health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 有充分证据表明，规律的体育活动能改善心理健康并提高学业表现。

ext.tip: strong at表示擅长；strong通常是形容词。
senses: having great physical power or force
great in intensity, influence, or convincing power

ex.en: I was surprised to find flowers outside my door.
ex.zh: 发现门外放着鲜花，我很惊讶。

ext.tip: surprised形容人的感受；surprising形容事物令人惊讶。
senses: Feeling that something unexpected has happened.

ex.en: A tall tree shades our garden in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午，一棵高大的树为我们的花园遮阴。

ex.en: Tall buildings can accommodate more residents, but careful planning is needed to preserve sunlight and public space.
ex.zh: 高层建筑可以容纳更多居民，但需要精心规划，以保留阳光和公共空间。

ext.tip: 人、树、楼通常用tall；山通常用high。

ex.en: The soup tasted terrible, so I made a sandwich.
ex.zh: 汤很难喝，于是我做了个三明治。

ex.en: Poor waste management can have terrible consequences for public health, especially in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 垃圾管理不善可能给公共健康带来严重后果，在人口密集的城市尤其如此。

ext.tip: terrible是形容词；表示“非常”通常用terribly。
senses: Causing great fear, suffering, or harm.

ex.en: She placed the star on top of the tree.
ex.zh: 她把那颗星星放在树顶上。

ex.en: Improving access to affordable housing should be a top priority for governments facing rapid urban population growth.
ex.zh: 对于面临城市人口快速增长的政府来说，改善居民获得可负担住房的机会应是首要任务。

ext.tip: on top of指在上面；at the top of指在顶端。
senses: the highest part or surface of something
highest in position, rank, or quality
to rank highest or be greater than something

ex.en: This thick blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
ex.zh: 这条厚毯子让我在凉飕飕的夜晚保持暖和。

ex.en: A warm welcome at school can help new students feel included and develop confidence.
ex.zh: 学校的热情欢迎能帮助新生获得归属感，并建立自信。

ext.tip: warm比hot温度低；warm to某人指渐渐喜欢对方。
senses: having a comfortable temperature that is not hot
to become warmer or make something warmer

ex.en: I felt too weak to carry the shopping upstairs.
ex.zh: 我觉得浑身无力，没法把买来的东西提上楼。

ex.en: Policies based on weak evidence may fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.
ex.zh: 依据薄弱证据制定的政策可能无法解决失业的根本原因。

ext.tip: weak与week同音；weakness可指弱点，也可指虚弱。
senses: not effective, convincing, or well supported
having little intensity, flavour, or power

ex.en: My socks got wet when I stepped in a puddle.
ex.zh: 我踩进水坑，把袜子弄湿了。

ex.en: Prolonged wet weather can damage crops and make it harder for farmers to harvest them efficiently.
ex.zh: 持续的阴雨天气会损害庄稼，使农民更难高效收获。

ext.tip: damp指微湿；soaking wet表示湿透。
senses: Covered with or containing water or another liquid
To put water or another liquid onto something

ex.en: The weather grew worse as we climbed the hill.
ex.zh: 我们爬山时，天气变得更糟了。

ex.en: Traffic congestion may become worse unless cities invest in reliable and affordable public transport.
ex.zh: 除非城市投资建设可靠且价格合理的公共交通，否则交通拥堵可能进一步恶化。

ext.tip: bad和badly的比较级；最高级是worst。
senses: Less good or more unpleasant, harmful, or serious.

ex.en: That was the worst meal I have ever cooked.
ex.zh: 那是我做过的最糟糕的一顿饭。

ex.en: The worst effects of air pollution are often experienced by children and older people in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 在人口密集的城市，儿童和老年人往往受到空气污染最严重的影响。

ext.tip: worst是bad和badly的最高级；比较级是worse。
senses: Worse than all others in quality, condition, or effect.
More badly or severely than anyone or anything else.
最坏的情况；最糟的部分
The most unpleasant situation, outcome, or part.

ex.en: I took the wrong bus and ended up near the airport.
ex.zh: 我坐错了公交车，结果到了机场附近。

ex.en: It is wrong to deny children educational opportunities simply because their families cannot afford school fees.
ex.zh: 仅仅因为家庭付不起学费就剥夺儿童受教育的机会，是不正当的。

ext.tip: go wrong表示出问题；wrong的词首w不发音。
senses: In an incorrect way, or with an unsuccessful result.

ex.en: My grandmother learned to swim at the age of seventy.
ex.zh: 我奶奶七十岁时学会了游泳。

ex.en: As populations age, governments need to invest more in accessible housing and community healthcare services.
ex.zh: 随着人口老龄化，政府需要加大对无障碍住房和社区医疗服务的投入。

ext.tip: 表示在几岁时用at the age of，不用in。
senses: The length of time someone or something has existed.
A period of history with particular features.
To become older or make someone or something seem older.

ex.en: He pulled on his cap before leaving for practice.
ex.zh: 他戴上帽子后出门去训练。

ex.en: Governments could cap annual rent increases to protect households from sudden rises in housing costs.
ex.zh: 政府可以限制年度租金涨幅，以保护家庭免受住房成本骤增的影响。

ext.tip: cap作动词指设上限；a cap on后接受限项目。
senses: a soft hat, often with a stiff front part
a cover fitted over the end or opening of something
to set a maximum amount or level for something

ex.en: My cousin returned from China with beautiful mountain photographs.
ex.zh: 我的表亲从中国回来，带回了漂亮的山景照片。

ex.en: The expansion of high-speed rail in China illustrates how transport investment can improve connections between major cities.
ex.zh: 中国高铁网络的扩展说明了交通投资如何改善主要城市之间的联系。

ext.tip: China指中国；小写china指瓷器，形容词用Chinese。

ex.en: The main difference between these jackets is their weight.
ex.zh: 这两件夹克的主要区别在于重量。

ex.en: Understanding cultural differences can help international students adapt more successfully to life in a new country.
ex.zh: 了解文化差异有助于留学生更顺利地适应新国家的生活。

ext.tip: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。
senses: A way in which people or things are not alike
A disagreement between people or groups
The amount by which one quantity exceeds another

ex.en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
ex.zh: 作为一名足球迷，我几乎不错过任何一场比赛。

ex.en: Sports fans can strengthen local communities by supporting neighbourhood teams and participating in shared events.
ex.zh: 体育迷可以通过支持社区球队、参与共同活动来增强当地社区的凝聚力。

ext.tip: 表示“……的爱好者”用a fan of。
senses: someone who greatly enjoys or admires a person or thing
a device or object moved to create a cooling airflow
to move air towards something, or make a feeling stronger

ex.en: Your idea of growing herbs on the balcony sounds lovely.
ex.zh: 你在阳台上种香草的主意听起来很棒。

ex.en: The idea of free public transport attracts support, but its financial implications require careful consideration.
ex.zh: 免费公共交通这一想法获得了支持，但其财政影响需要慎重考虑。

ext.tip: idea是可数名词；“不知道”可说have no idea。
senses: A thought or suggestion about what to do.
A mental understanding or belief about something.
Some knowledge or understanding of a situation.

ex.en: Our kind neighbour brought us soup when we were ill.
ex.zh: 我们生病时，体贴的邻居给我们送来了汤。

ext.tip: 形容词常接to；种类用a kind of加名词。
senses: Caring about others and willing to help them.
A group of things sharing similar features.

ex.en: The washing machine shook loudly during its final spin.
ex.zh: 洗衣机在最后脱水时剧烈晃动，声音很大。

ext.tip: machine是可数名词；machinery是不可数集合名词。
senses: A device with moving parts that performs a particular job.
To shape or finish material using a machine.

ex.en: These pants have deep pockets for my keys.
ex.zh: 这条裤子的口袋很深，可以装我的钥匙。

ex.en: Some schools allow students to wear comfortable pants rather than requiring a traditional formal uniform.
ex.zh: 有些学校允许学生穿舒适的裤子，而不要求穿传统的正式校服。

ext.tip: 美式指裤子，英式常指内裤；用 a pair of 计数。
senses: Clothing covering the legs separately, from the waist down.
Underwear worn around the hips and bottom.

ex.en: We pass a small bakery on our way home.
ex.zh: 我们回家的路上会经过一家小面包店。

ex.en: Students must pass a practical assessment before they can begin working independently in the laboratory.
ex.zh: 学生必须通过实践考核，才能开始在实验室独立工作。

ext.tip: pass是动词；past可作介词：walk past。
senses: To move past something or through a place.
To give something to another person.
To achieve the required standard in an examination or test.

ex.en: Several people were waiting outside the bakery this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，有几个人在面包店外等候。

ex.en: Cities should provide accessible public transport so that people of all ages can travel independently.
ex.zh: 城市应提供无障碍公共交通，让各年龄段的人都能独立出行。

col: people from all walks of life
ext.tip: 表示人们时用people；peoples指多个民族。
senses: Human beings considered together or referred to in general.
A group sharing a culture, history, or national identity.

ex.en: She cut the biscuits into the shape of stars.
ex.zh: 她把饼干坯切成了星星的形状。

ex.en: Early childhood experiences can shape attitudes towards learning and influence future educational achievement.
ex.zh: 幼年经历可以塑造学习态度，并影响未来的学业成就。

ext.tip: in shape可指身体状态好，不只表示形状。
senses: to give something a particular physical form

ex.en: My aunt taught me how to bake bread.
ex.zh: 我姨妈教会了我如何烤面包。

ex.en: Extended family members, such as aunts and uncles, often provide valuable childcare support for working parents.
ex.zh: 姑姨叔舅等大家庭成员常为在职父母提供宝贵的育儿支持。

ext.tip: 不区分父系或母系；美音也常读/ɑːnt/。
senses: Your parent's sister, or the wife of your parent's sibling.

ex.en: Their daughter made pancakes for the whole family.
ex.zh: 他们的女儿给全家人做了薄煎饼。

ex.en: Equal access to education ensures that daughters and sons have similar opportunities to develop their talents.
ex.zh: 平等的受教育机会确保女儿和儿子都能有相近的机会发展自身才能。

ext.tip: daughter-in-law是儿媳，不是继女。

ex.en: Each parent brought a snack for the school picnic.
ex.zh: 每位家长都为学校野餐带了一份点心。

ex.en: Schools should involve parents in educational decisions because family support plays an important role in children's learning.
ex.zh: 学校应让家长参与教育决策，因为家庭支持在孩子的学习中发挥着重要作用。

ext.tip: parent指父母中的一位；parents通常指父母双方。
senses: a company that owns or controls another company
to raise and care for a child as a parent

ex.en: Their son helped them plant flowers in the garden.
ex.zh: 他们的儿子帮他们在花园里种花。

ex.en: Parents should give their sons and daughters equal opportunities to pursue education and develop practical skills.
ex.zh: 父母应给予儿子和女儿平等的机会，让他们接受教育并培养实用技能。

senses: A male child in relation to his parents.

ex.en: My uncle taught me how to mend a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我叔叔教过我怎样修自行车。

ex.en: An uncle or aunt can provide valuable emotional support when parents are busy with work commitments.
ex.zh: 父母忙于工作时，叔伯姑姨等亲属可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

ext.tip: uncle不区分父母哪一方，也不区分长幼。
senses: a parent's brother or an aunt's husband

ex.en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 她出门前把水瓶装满了。

ext.tip: a bottle of water是一瓶水；water bottle是水瓶。
senses: A narrow-necked container for liquids, or the amount it holds.
To put a liquid into bottles for storage or sale.

ex.en: I added some cheese to my warm vegetable sandwich.
ex.zh: 我在热乎乎的蔬菜三明治里加了些奶酪。

ex.en: Although cheese provides protein and calcium, some varieties contain high levels of salt and saturated fat.
ex.zh: 虽然奶酪能提供蛋白质和钙，但有些品种的盐和饱和脂肪含量较高。

ext.tip: 通常不可数；一块奶酪用a piece of cheese。
senses: A food made by pressing or ripening the solids of milk.

ex.en: I drink coffee with milk before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 我上班出门前会喝一杯加奶咖啡。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may threaten coffee production, affecting the incomes of farmers in several developing countries.
ex.zh: 气温上升可能威胁咖啡生产，影响一些发展中国家农民的收入。

ext.tip: 通常不可数；点单时two coffees指两杯咖啡。
senses: A drink made from roasted beans, or the beans and powder.

ex.en: I warmed my hands around a cup of tea.
ex.zh: 我双手捧着一杯茶取暖。

ext.tip: a cup of后接饮品；cup作动词可表示用手捧住。
senses: A small drinking container, or the amount it holds.
A decorative container awarded for winning a competition.
To curve your hands into a hollow shape to hold something.

ex.en: The ball hit the window and shattered the glass.
ex.zh: 球砸中了窗户，把玻璃打碎了。

ex.en: Recycling glass reduces demand for raw materials and can lower energy consumption in the manufacturing sector.
ex.zh: 回收玻璃能减少对原材料的需求，并可降低制造业的能源消耗。

ext.tip: 玻璃不可数，玻璃杯可数；眼镜用复数glasses。
senses: A hard, usually transparent material used for windows and containers.
A drinking container, or the amount it holds.
Lenses held in a frame worn to improve sight.

ex.en: I felt hungry after our long walk by the river.
ex.zh: 在河边走了很久之后，我觉得饿了。

ex.en: School meal programmes help hungry children concentrate in class and participate more actively in learning.
ex.zh: 学校供餐计划帮助饥饿的孩子集中课堂注意力，更积极地参与学习。

ext.tip: hungry for后接名词，表示渴望某物。
senses: Feeling the need or desire to eat.
Having a strong desire for something.

ex.en: Use a sharp knife to slice the bread.
ex.zh: 用一把锋利的刀把面包切成片。

ex.en: Learning to use a kitchen knife safely is an important part of practical food education.
ex.zh: 学习安全使用菜刀是实用饮食教育的重要组成部分。

ext.tip: k不发音；复数把-fe变为-ves：knives。
senses: a tool with a handle and blade used for cutting

ex.en: She placed a warm pancake on my plate.
ex.zh: 她在我的盘子里放了一张热乎乎的薄煎饼。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce food waste by offering smaller plates and allowing customers to request extra portions.
ex.zh: 餐馆可以提供较小的餐盘，并允许顾客要求加量，从而减少食物浪费。

ext.tip: plate通常指浅盘，bowl指较深的碗。
senses: A flat, usually round dish used for serving food.
A flat piece of metal or another hard material.
To cover an object with a thin layer of metal.

ex.en: I made a pot of tea while you rested.
ex.zh: 你休息的时候，我泡了一壶茶。

ex.en: In many cultures, sharing tea provides an opportunity for conversation and strengthens relationships between generations.
ex.zh: 在许多文化中，一起喝茶为交谈提供了机会，也增进了代际关系。

ext.tip: 茶水通常不可数；点单时two teas指两杯茶。
senses: a drink made by putting tea leaves in hot water
dried leaves used to make tea
a light afternoon meal or, in Britain, an early evening meal

ex.en: We walked along the river and watched the ducks.
ex.zh: 我们沿着河边散步，看着水里的鸭子。

ex.en: Planting trees along busy roads can provide shade for pedestrians and improve the appearance of urban areas.
ex.zh: 在繁忙道路沿线植树可以为行人遮阴，并改善城市面貌。

ext.tip: along沿着长线走；across强调从一边横穿到另一边。
senses: following the length or direction of something
forward from one place towards another
with someone when they go somewhere

ex.en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
ex.zh: 这个杯子裂了，请再给我拿一个。

ex.en: Another reason to invest in public transport is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通的另一个理由是，它有望减少城市空气污染。

ext.tip: 通常接单数名词；another two days表示再两天。
senses: one more, or a different one
one more person or thing, or a different one

ex.en: You can borrow any book from this shelf.
ex.zh: 这个书架上的书，你想借哪本都可以。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all children can attend school without facing any financial barriers.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有儿童都能上学，不受任何经济障碍的阻碍。

ext.tip: 疑问、否定句中常表“一些”；肯定句中常表“任何”。
senses: Some in questions or negatives; whichever one, without restriction.
Some or whichever ones, without naming the people or things.
At all, used mainly with comparisons in questions or negatives.

ex.en: We sat around the fire and watched the stars.
ex.zh: 我们围坐在火堆旁看星星。

ex.en: Planting trees around school buildings can provide shade and reduce indoor temperatures during hot weather.
ex.zh: 在教学楼周围种树可以提供遮阴，并在炎热天气下降低室内温度。

ext.tip: around可表大约；around ten即十点或十个左右。
senses: On different sides of something or surrounding it.
In or to various places within an area.

ex.en: I closed the window because the room felt cold.
ex.zh: 我关上了窗户，因为房间里有点冷。

ex.en: Many commuters choose public transport because it is cheaper and produces fewer emissions than driving alone.
ex.zh: 许多通勤者选择公共交通，因为它比独自开车更省钱，排放也更少。

ext.tip: because 后接从句；because of 后接名词或动名词。
senses: Introduces the reason why something happens or is true.

ex.en: Both windows were open, letting in the cool breeze.
ex.zh: 两扇窗户都开着，凉风吹了进来。

ex.en: Both governments and individuals have a responsibility to reduce waste and protect natural resources.
ex.zh: 政府和个人都有责任减少浪费并保护自然资源。

ext.tip: both指两者；both A and B作主语用复数谓语。
senses: referring to two people or things together
the two people or things already mentioned

ex.en: This wooden bowl was made by my grandfather.
ex.zh: 这个木碗是我祖父做的。

ex.en: Urban air quality can be improved by expanding public transport and encouraging residents to cycle more often.
ex.zh: 扩大公共交通服务并鼓励居民更多骑车，可以改善城市空气质量。

ext.tip: by表示截止时间；until表示状态持续到某时。
senses: Shows who or what performs an action in passive sentences.
Using a particular method or means.
No later than a particular time.

ex.en: The cat jumped down from the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 猫从厨房的桌子上跳了下来。

ex.en: As housing costs go up, the amount young adults can save often goes down.
ex.zh: 随着住房成本上涨，年轻人能存下的钱往往会减少。

ext.tip: down后接名词可作介词；feel down表示心情低落。
senses: Towards or in a lower place or position.
Along something, or from a higher to a lower point.

ex.en: Everyone brought a dish to share at the picnic.
ex.zh: 每个人都带了一道菜，在野餐时一起分享。

ex.en: Public libraries should ensure that everyone can access reliable information, regardless of income or educational background.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应确保每个人都能获取可靠信息，不论收入或教育背景如何。

ext.tip: everyone接单数谓语；every one强调逐个。
senses: Every person in a group, or all people.

ex.en: Everything in my bag got wet during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨把我包里的东西全弄湿了。

ex.en: Although digital resources are valuable, students should not assume that everything they read online is accurate.
ex.zh: 虽然数字资源很有价值，但学生不应认为自己在网上读到的一切都准确无误。

ext.tip: 作主语时谓语用单数：Everything is ready。
senses: All things or all the things in a particular situation.
The most important thing in someone's life or situation.

ex.en: Your keys are inside the small pocket of your bag.
ex.zh: 你的钥匙在包的小口袋里。

ex.en: Air quality inside buildings deserves greater attention because many people spend most of their day indoors.
ex.zh: 建筑物内部的空气质量值得更多关注，因为许多人一天中的大部分时间都在室内度过。

ext.tip: inside后接名词时是介词；单独用可作副词。
senses: in or into the inner part of something
in or into an enclosed place or container
the inner part or surface of something

ex.en: The kitten jumped into the basket beside my chair.
ex.zh: 小猫跳进了我椅子旁的篮子里。

ex.en: Converting unused offices into affordable housing could help cities address shortages without expanding into surrounding countryside.
ex.zh: 将闲置办公室改造成经济适用住房，可帮助城市缓解住房短缺，而不必向周边乡村扩张。

ext.tip: into强调进入的过程；in通常表示在里面。
senses: used to show the result of a change
interested in or enthusiastic about something

ex.en: I need just one more minute to finish packing.
ex.zh: 我只需要再一分钟就能收拾好行李。

ex.en: A just society should ensure that all children can access quality education, regardless of family income.
ex.zh: 一个公正的社会应确保所有儿童都能获得优质教育，不受家庭收入影响。

ext.tip: 作副词可指仅仅、刚刚；作形容词指公正的。
senses: Only; no more than a particular amount or thing.
Very recently, or exactly at a particular point or degree.

ex.en: Could you add more rice to my bowl, please?
ex.zh: 请再给我的碗里添点米饭，好吗？

ex.en: Governments should invest more resources in preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
ex.zh: 政府应加大对预防保健的资源投入，以长期减轻医院的压力。

ext.tip: 可修饰可数或不可数名词；是 many、much 的比较级。
senses: A greater or additional amount or number of something.
To a greater degree or extent.
A greater or additional amount or number.

ex.en: Most shops here close before we finish work.
ex.zh: 这里大多数商店在我们下班前就关门了。

ex.en: Most urban residents would benefit from reliable public transport that connects residential areas with major employment centres.
ex.zh: 大多数城市居民都会受益于连接住宅区与主要就业中心的可靠公共交通。

ext.tip: 泛指用most people；特指用most of the people。
senses: the majority of something, or the greatest amount or number
the majority or greatest part of a group or amount
to the greatest degree; sometimes used to mean very

ex.en: I made myself a sandwich before the walk.
ex.zh: 散步前，我给自己做了个三明治。

ex.en: By volunteering at a community garden, I taught myself practical skills that formal education rarely provides.
ex.zh: 通过在社区花园做志愿者，我自学了正规教育很少传授的实用技能。

ext.tip: by myself表示独自或独立；不能用myself代替主语I。
senses: Used when I am both the person acting and receiving.
Used to emphasize that I personally do something.

ex.en: I opened the fridge, but there was nothing inside.
ex.zh: 我打开冰箱，里面却什么也没有。

ex.en: Without affordable public transport, some residents have nothing to rely on except their own cars.
ex.zh: 如果没有价格合理的公共交通，一些居民除了自己的汽车便无可依靠。

ext.tip: nothing本身含否定意义，通常不再与not连用。
senses: not anything; no thing at all
not at all, used to strengthen certain comparisons

ex.en: The dog ran off when the gate opened.
ex.zh: 门一开，那只狗就跑走了。

ex.en: Keeping unnecessary lights off in public buildings can reduce electricity consumption and lower operating costs.
ex.zh: 关闭公共建筑内不必要的照明可以减少耗电量并降低运营成本。

ext.tip: off强调离开或关闭；of常表示所属，勿混淆。
senses: away from a place or position
away from or no longer touching something
not operating or not working at a particular time

ex.en: We often walk by the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们经常在晚饭后沿河散步。

ex.en: People who exercise regularly often report better sleep and higher energy levels throughout the day.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼的人往往表示，他们睡得更好，白天也更有精力。

ext.tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；t也可发音。
senses: many times or on many occasions

ex.en: We went out for a walk after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后我们出去散步了。

ex.en: When a new research report comes out, journalists should examine its evidence before reporting its conclusions.
ex.zh: 新的研究报告发布时，记者应先审查其证据，再报道其结论。

ext.tip: out 常作副词；在某物外面可用 outside。
senses: Away from the inside of a place, or from home.
No longer burning, shining, or working.
Available to the public or no longer secret.

ex.en: The children played outside while their parents prepared lunch.
ex.zh: 父母准备午饭时，孩子们在外面玩耍。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for students to learn outside the classroom through practical activities and community projects.
ex.zh: 学校应通过实践活动和社区项目，为学生提供课堂之外的学习机会。

ext.tip: 后接地点用介词 outside；单独使用可作副词。
senses: In or towards a place that is not inside.
Beyond the boundaries or limits of something.
Located on the outer part or coming from elsewhere.

ex.en: We quickly packed our bags when the taxi arrived.
ex.zh: 出租车一到，我们就迅速收拾好了行李。

ex.en: Cities must respond quickly to extreme weather events to protect vulnerable residents and maintain essential services.
ex.zh: 城市必须迅速应对极端天气事件，以保护弱势居民并维持基本服务。

ext.tip: quickly是副词，修饰动作；quick是形容词，修饰名词。
senses: At a fast speed or after only a short time.

ex.en: She slowly poured the hot soup into bowls.
ex.zh: 她慢慢地把热汤倒进碗里。

ex.en: Although public attitudes are changing slowly, more consumers are choosing products with less plastic packaging.
ex.zh: 尽管公众观念改变得较慢，但越来越多的消费者正在选择塑料包装更少的产品。

ext.tip: slowly是副词，修饰动作；slow通常作形容词。
senses: At a low speed or over a long time.

ex.en: Someone left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
ex.zh: 有人把一把蓝色雨伞落在了前门旁边。

ex.en: Students may feel more confident seeking help when someone they trust is available to discuss their concerns.
ex.zh: 如果有信任的人可以倾听他们的困扰，学生求助时可能会更有信心。

ext.tip: 作主语时谓语用单数；后文可用they指代。
senses: a person whose identity is unknown or not stated

ex.en: There is something soft inside this little box.
ex.zh: 这个小盒子里有个柔软的东西。

ex.en: Learning something new every day can help adults remain curious and adapt to changes in the workplace.
ex.zh: 每天学习一点新东西，有助于成年人保持好奇心并适应职场变化。

ext.tip: 修饰词放后面，如something useful；作主语用单数。
senses: A thing that is not named or specified.

ex.en: My new backpack is lighter than my old one.
ex.zh: 我的新背包比旧的轻。

ex.en: Investing in public transport may be more effective than building additional roads in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在拥挤的城市，投资公共交通可能比增建道路更有效。

ext.tip: than用于比较；then表示“然后”，注意拼写。
senses: used to introduce the second thing in a comparison
used before a clause expressing the other side of a comparison

ex.en: The child looked up at the bright red balloon.
ex.zh: 孩子抬头看着那个鲜红的气球。

ex.en: As housing costs go up, many young adults find it harder to live independently.
ex.zh: 随着住房成本上涨，许多年轻人发现独立生活变得更加困难。

ext.tip: up后接地点名词可作介词，如up the hill。
senses: Towards or in a higher position.
Towards a higher point or further along something.

ex.en: When does the next bus leave for town?
ex.zh: 下一班去镇上的公交车什么时候发车？

ex.en: When cities invest in reliable public transport, residents are more likely to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 当城市投资建设可靠的公共交通时，居民就更可能不开私家车出行。

ext.tip: 表将来的时间从句中，when后通常用一般现在时。
senses: At the time that something happens.

ex.en: Why are your shoes still wet this morning?
ex.zh: 为什么你的鞋今天早上还是湿的？

ex.en: Researchers need to understand why some students leave education before completing their secondary school qualifications.
ex.zh: 研究人员需要了解，为什么有些学生尚未取得中学学历就离开了学校。

ext.tip: 间接疑问句用陈述语序：I know why he left。
senses: used to ask about the reason for something
introduces the reason for a situation or action

ex.en: My hands were cold, so I put on gloves.
ex.zh: 我的手很冷，于是戴上了手套。

ex.en: Cold weather can increase household energy costs, placing additional pressure on families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 寒冷天气会增加家庭能源开支，给收入有限的家庭带来额外压力。

ext.tip: “觉得冷”用be cold；“感冒了”用have a cold。
senses: Having a low temperature or feeling a lack of warmth.
A common illness causing sneezing, coughing, and a runny nose.
Showing little friendliness, affection, or sympathy.

ex.en: The baby began to cry when her toy fell.
ex.zh: 玩具掉了，宝宝就哭了起来。

ex.en: Young children may cry when separated from their parents, so schools should provide a welcoming environment.
ex.zh: 幼儿与父母分开时可能会哭，因此学校应营造亲切友好的环境。

ext.tip: 过去式cried；现在分词crying；表示喊叫常用cry out。
senses: Produce tears because of sadness, pain, or strong emotion.
Call out loudly because of strong emotion or urgent need.
A loud sound expressing emotion or attracting attention.

ex.en: The doctor listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
ex.zh: 我描述症状时，医生认真地听着。

ex.en: Governments should train more doctors to ensure that rural communities have reliable access to healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应培养更多医生，确保农村社区能够稳定获得医疗服务。

ext.tip: 看医生常说see a doctor；动词doctor可指篡改。
senses: a trained professional who diagnoses and treats illnesses
a person who has earned the highest university degree
to change something dishonestly to deceive people

ex.en: Golden leaves fall onto the path outside our house.
ex.zh: 金黄的叶子落在我们屋外的小路上。

ex.en: Energy consumption may fall if governments encourage households to install better insulation and efficient heating systems.
ex.zh: 如果政府鼓励家庭改善隔热条件并安装高效供暖系统，能源消耗可能会下降。

ext.tip: 过去式fell，过去分词fallen；秋天英式常用autumn。
senses: To move downward, lose balance, or decrease.
An act of falling or a decrease in amount.
The season between summer and winter, especially in American English.

ex.en: I feel fine now, so let's go for a walk.
ex.zh: 我现在感觉挺好的，我们去散步吧。

ex.en: A substantial fine may discourage companies from dumping industrial waste into rivers and damaging local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 高额罚款可能会阻止企业向河流倾倒工业废物、破坏当地生态系统。

ext.tip: fine作动词也指罚款：fine sb for sth。
senses: Good, satisfactory, healthy, or of high quality.
Made of very small particles or having little thickness.
Money that must be paid as punishment for breaking rules.

ex.en: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
ex.zh: 她在当地医院当护士。

ex.en: Building a new hospital in the region would improve access to specialist care for rural communities.
ex.zh: 在该地区新建一家医院将有助于农村居民获得专科医疗服务。

ext.tip: 住院：英式in hospital，美式in the hospital。
senses: A place where ill or injured people receive medical treatment.

ex.en: I felt ill after the long bus journey.
ex.zh: 长途乘车后，我感到身体不适。

ex.en: Employees who are ill should be encouraged to rest rather than return to work immediately.
ex.zh: 应鼓励生病的员工休息，而不是立即返岗。

ext.tip: 表示生病时通常作表语：be ill。
senses: Suffering from a disease or feeling unwell.
In a bad or unkind way.

ex.en: We can discuss this matter after lunch today.
ex.zh: 我们可以今天午饭后讨论这件事。

ex.en: The quality of teaching matters more than expensive equipment when schools aim to improve student achievement.
ex.zh: 学校若想提高学生成绩，教学质量比昂贵的设备更重要。

ext.tip: 指事情时通常可数；指物质时不可数；作动词表示要紧。
senses: a subject, situation or problem needing thought or attention
to be important or make a difference
physical substance that occupies space and has mass

ex.en: The nurse gently wrapped a bandage around my wrist.
ex.zh: 护士轻轻地用绷带包住我的手腕。

ex.en: Employing more community nurses could improve access to healthcare for older people living in rural areas.
ex.zh: 增聘社区护士可以改善农村老年人获得医疗服务的机会。

ext.tip: 作动词可直接接人：nurse a patient。
senses: A trained person who cares for ill or injured people.
To care for someone who is ill or injured.

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he felt sick this morning.
ex.zh: 他今天早上觉得不舒服，所以一直躺在床上。

ex.en: Paid sick leave allows employees to recover at home and reduces the spread of infections in workplaces.
ex.zh: 带薪病假让员工能在家康复，并减少感染在工作场所传播。

ext.tip: 英式英语中be sick常指呕吐，feel sick常指恶心。
senses: Suffering from an illness or feeling unwell.
Very annoyed or tired of someone or something.

ex.en: I felt too tired to cook after the walk.
ex.zh: 散步后我累得不想做饭。

ex.en: Employees who regularly work long hours may become too tired to perform their duties safely.
ex.zh: 经常长时间工作的员工可能会疲惫不堪，无法安全地履行职责。

ext.tip: tired形容人感到累；tiring形容事情令人累。
senses: needing rest or sleep because of physical or mental effort
annoyed or bored by something that continues or repeats

ex.en: Please send me your address before I post the parcel.
ex.zh: 请在我寄包裹之前把你的地址发给我。

ex.en: Governments need to address housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving public transport links.
ex.zh: 政府需要通过支持可负担住房建设和改善公共交通连接来应对住房短缺。

ext.tip: 美音动词读/əˈdres/；address问题不等于已解决。
senses: Details identifying where someone lives or something can be found.
To give attention to a problem and try to solve it.
To speak directly to a person or group.

ex.en: I went downstairs when I smelled fresh bread.
ex.zh: 闻到新鲜面包的香味后，我下了楼。

ex.en: Providing a downstairs bedroom can help older residents remain independent in their own homes.
ex.zh: 在楼下设置卧室可以帮助老年住户在自己家中保持独立生活。

ext.tip: 作副词时直接说go downstairs，不加to。
senses: On or towards a lower floor of a building
Located on a lower floor of a building

ex.en: Last night, I had a dream about flying over mountains.
ex.zh: 昨晚我做了一个飞越群山的梦。

ext.tip: dream of/about后接名词或动名词；过去式可用dreamt或dreamed。
senses: images, feelings, and events experienced while sleeping
something you strongly hope to achieve or experience
to experience dreams while sleeping or imagine something you want

ex.en: I left my house key in my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 我把家门钥匙放在外套口袋里了。

ex.en: Access to reliable information is key to helping consumers make informed decisions about their health.
ex.zh: 获取可靠信息是帮助消费者就自身健康作出明智决定的关键。

ext.tip: the key to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。
senses: An object shaped to open or close a particular lock.
Something essential for understanding or achieving something.
Extremely important to a situation or its outcome.

ex.en: Can you help me lift this box onto the shelf?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这个箱子抬到架子上吗？

ex.en: Installing lifts in older public buildings can improve access for wheelchair users and people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 在较老的公共建筑中安装电梯，可以方便轮椅使用者和行动不便的人进出。

ext.tip: 电梯英式用lift，美式用elevator。
senses: To move someone or something to a higher position.
A machine carrying people or goods between floors.
A ride in someone else's vehicle.

ex.en: Please leave a message if I miss your call.
ex.zh: 如果我没接到你的电话，请留言。

ex.en: Public health campaigns need a clear message that people from different backgrounds can easily understand.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传需要传达清晰的信息，让不同背景的人都能轻松理解。

ext.tip: message是可数名词；information通常不可数。
senses: Information sent or left for someone to read or hear.
The main idea that a story, speech, or artwork communicates.
To send someone an electronic communication.

ex.en: Rain drummed on the roof throughout the night.
ex.zh: 雨点整夜敲打着屋顶。

ex.en: Installing solar panels on the roof can help households lower electricity bills and reduce their environmental impact.
ex.zh: 在屋顶安装太阳能板，可以帮助家庭降低电费并减少对环境的影响。

ext.tip: 复数是roofs；roof指外部屋顶，ceiling指室内天花板。
senses: the top covering of a building or vehicle
to cover a building with a roof

ex.en: She saved me a seat near the front.
ex.zh: 她在靠前的位置给我留了一个座位。

ex.en: Providing more seats on public transport would make daily travel easier for older passengers and families.
ex.zh: 在公共交通工具上增加座位，会让老年乘客和家庭的日常出行更方便。

ext.tip: sit是不及物动词；seat常接人，be seated表就座。
senses: A place or object for someone to sit on.
To provide a sitting place or have room for seated people.
A position as a member of an elected body.

ex.en: I always take a warm shower after cycling home.
ex.zh: 我骑车回家后总会洗个温水澡。

ex.en: Taking shorter showers is a simple way for households to reduce both water consumption and energy use.
ex.zh: 缩短淋浴时间是家庭减少用水和能源消耗的一种简单方法。

ext.tip: 洗淋浴可用take或have a shower；阵雨也叫shower。
senses: Washing under falling water, or the equipment used for this
Wash your body under water falling from a shower

ex.en: I left my glasses upstairs beside the bed.
ex.zh: 我把眼镜落在楼上的床边了。

ex.en: Moving bedrooms upstairs can provide greater privacy in homes where the ground floor is used for work.
ex.zh: 在底层用于办公的住宅中，把卧室搬到楼上可以提供更多私密空间。

ext.tip: 作副词时前面不加to：go upstairs。
senses: On or towards a higher floor of a building.
Located on a higher floor of a building.

ex.en: Please wash your hands before you help prepare dinner.
ex.zh: 帮忙准备晚餐前，请先洗手。

ex.en: Schools should teach children to wash their hands properly to reduce the spread of infectious diseases.
ex.zh: 学校应教孩子正确洗手，以减少传染病的传播。

ext.tip: wash强调用水洗；clean泛指清洁，不一定用水。
senses: To clean something using water, often with soap.
To carry or move something through flowing water.
An act of cleaning with water.

ex.en: I usually cook vegetable soup when the weather turns cold.
ex.zh: 天气变冷时，我通常会煮蔬菜汤。

ex.en: Teaching children to cook simple meals can encourage healthier eating habits and greater independence later in life.
ex.zh: 教孩子做简单饭菜，可以培养更健康的饮食习惯，让他们日后更加独立。

ext.tip: cook可指厨师；cooker在英式英语中指炉灶。
senses: to prepare food by heating it, or become ready through heating
someone who prepares and cooks food

ex.en: The farmer feeds her chickens before the sun rises.
ex.zh: 这位农民在日出前给她的鸡喂食。

ex.en: Small farmers need reliable access to water and affordable technology to maintain production during dry periods.
ex.zh: 小农户需要可靠的水源和负担得起的技术，才能在干旱期间维持生产。

ext.tip: farmer指人，farm指农场，farming指农业生产。
senses: someone who grows crops or raises animals on a farm

ex.en: My sister found a job at the local library.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在当地图书馆找到了一份工作。

ex.en: Access to practical training can help young people secure a job in a competitive labour market.
ex.zh: 获得实用技能培训能帮助年轻人在竞争激烈的劳动力市场中找到工作。

ext.tip: job指具体工作，可数；work泛指工作，通常不可数。
senses: paid work that someone does regularly
a particular task or piece of work

ex.en: We watched the stars from our tent beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边的帐篷里仰望星空。

ex.en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars, reducing their connection with the natural night sky.
ex.zh: 光污染使许多城市居民看不到星星，削弱了他们与自然夜空的联系。

ext.tip: star in表示“主演”；过去式starred，进行式starring。
senses: a huge ball of hot gas shining in space
a famous or exceptionally successful performer or other person
to play a leading role or feature someone doing so

ex.en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
ex.zh: 她希望明年夏天去另一个国家旅行。

ex.en: Each country should develop energy policies that reflect its natural resources and long-term environmental goals.
ex.zh: 各国都应根据本国自然资源和长期环境目标制定能源政策。

ext.tip: 表示“乡下”常用 the country，与国家义区分。
senses: An area of land governed as an independent political unit.
Land outside towns and cities, often with farms and villages.
A popular music style rooted in rural American traditions.

ex.en: We watched sheep grazing in the field behind our cottage.
ex.zh: 我们看着羊群在小屋后面的牧场上吃草。

ex.en: Research in the field of renewable energy could create employment opportunities and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 可再生能源领域的研究可以创造就业机会，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。

ext.tip: 表示研究或工作领域时，常用in the field of。
senses: an area of land used for crops or farm animals
a particular area of study or work
an area of ground used for playing a sport

ex.en: We spread a blanket on the grass beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边的草地上铺了一条毯子。

ex.en: Replacing natural grass with artificial surfaces can reduce habitats for insects and increase local temperatures.
ex.zh: 用人造地面取代天然草地可能减少昆虫的栖息地，并使当地气温升高。

ext.tip: 通常不可数；一片草叶用a blade of grass。
senses: A low plant with narrow green leaves covering the ground.

ex.en: We spread a blanket on the ground beneath a tree.
ex.zh: 我们在树下的地面上铺了一条毯子。

ex.en: Planting trees helps the ground retain moisture and reduces the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 植树有助于土地保持水分，并降低水土流失的风险。

ext.tip: 表示理由常用复数grounds；ground也是grind的过去式。
senses: The solid surface of the earth.
Reasons or evidence supporting a belief, decision, or action.
To prevent an aircraft from flying.

ex.en: We took a small boat to the island yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们乘小船去了那座岛。

ex.en: Small island communities often depend on tourism, but increasing visitor numbers can threaten fragile coastal environments.
ex.zh: 小岛上的社区往往依赖旅游业，但游客数量的增加可能威胁脆弱的海岸环境。

ext.tip: s不发音；在岛上用on an island。
senses: An area of land completely surrounded by water.

ex.en: We rented a small boat and crossed the lake.
ex.zh: 我们租了一条小船，划到了湖对岸。

ex.en: Agricultural pollution can damage lake ecosystems and threaten the communities that rely on them for drinking water.
ex.zh: 农业污染会破坏湖泊生态系统，并威胁依靠湖水获取饮用水的社区。

ext.tip: on the lake 指在湖面上；in the lake 指在湖水中。
senses: A large area of water surrounded by land.

ex.en: The moon rose slowly above the trees behind our house.
ex.zh: 月亮在我们屋后的树梢上缓缓升起。

ex.en: Research on the moon may help scientists understand how Earth and other rocky planets formed.
ex.zh: 对月球的研究可能帮助科学家了解地球和其他岩石行星的形成过程。

ext.tip: 指地球的月亮通常用the moon；其他行星的卫星可数。
senses: the natural object that moves around Earth
a natural object that moves around a planet

ex.en: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
ex.zh: 这株小植物需要更多阳光和更少的水。

ex.en: Local authorities should plant more trees to improve air quality and provide shade in crowded neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 地方政府应多种树，以改善空气质量，并为人口密集的社区提供绿荫。

ext.tip: plant可指植物或工厂；作动词时常表示种植。
senses: a living thing that usually grows in soil and has leaves
to put seeds or young plants into soil to grow
a factory or facility where industrial processes take place

ex.en: We watched ducks swimming across the river this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我们看着鸭子游过河面。

ex.en: Protecting river ecosystems requires cooperation between farming communities, local industries, and environmental agencies.
ex.zh: 保护河流生态系统需要农业社区、当地企业和环境机构之间的合作。

ext.tip: 河名通常带the，如the River Nile。
senses: a large natural stream of water flowing towards another water body

ex.en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
ex.zh: 过马路前要向两边看。

ex.en: Investment in road maintenance can improve public safety and reduce transport costs for local businesses.
ex.zh: 投资道路养护能提高公共安全水平，并降低当地企业的运输成本。

ext.tip: on the road常指在旅途中；road to可比喻通往某结果的途径。
senses: a hard surface built for vehicles to travel along
a way of reaching a particular result or situation

ex.en: We sat on a flat rock beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们坐在河边一块平坦的岩石上。

ex.en: Studying ancient rock layers helps scientists understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.
ex.zh: 研究古老的岩层有助于科学家了解地球气候随时间发生的变化。

ext.tip: rock 作岩石材料不可数；指一块石头时可数。
senses: The hard natural material forming much of Earth's surface.
Popular music with a strong beat, often featuring electric guitars.
Move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

ex.en: Our village has a bakery beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们村的老桥旁有一家面包店。

ex.en: Reliable public transport can help village residents access employment, education, and healthcare in nearby towns.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通可以帮助村民前往附近城镇就业、求学和就医。

ext.tip: the whole village可指全村居民，而非建筑。
senses: A small community of homes, usually in the countryside.
The people who live in a village, considered together.

ex.en: She dreams of travelling around the world by train.
ex.zh: 她梦想乘火车环游世界。

ex.en: Countries around the world need to cooperate more closely to address climate change and protect shared natural resources.
ex.zh: 世界各国需要更紧密地合作，以应对气候变化并保护共享的自然资源。

ext.tip: 指整个世界通常用the world；商界为the business world。
senses: The earth and all the people and things on it.
A particular area of activity and the people involved.

ex.en: This is my first visit to the seaside.
ex.zh: 这是我第一次到海边来。

ex.en: Governments should first improve public transport before encouraging residents to give up private cars.
ex.zh: 政府应先改善公共交通，再鼓励居民放弃私家车。

ext.tip: at first指起初；first可用于列举第一点。
senses: coming before all others in order or time

ex.en: The hall can hold about a hundred people.
ex.zh: 这个大厅大约能容纳一百人。

ex.en: Several hundred residents participated in the survey about proposed improvements to local parks and cycle routes.
ex.zh: 数百名居民参与了关于当地公园和自行车路线改进提案的调查。

ext.tip: 具体数词后用hundred；泛指数百用hundreds of。
senses: the number equal to ten times ten

ex.en: I left my favourite pair of gloves on the bus.
ex.zh: 我把最喜欢的那双手套落在公交车上了。

ex.en: Teachers often pair students with different strengths to encourage cooperation and improve learning outcomes.
ex.zh: 教师常将各有所长的学生配成一组，以鼓励合作并改善学习成效。

ext.tip: a pair of shoes作主语时，谓语用单数。
senses: Two matching things, or one object with two connected parts.
Two people who are together or work together.
To put people or things together in groups of two.

ex.en: This is my second cup of tea today.
ex.zh: 这是我今天喝的第二杯茶。

ex.en: Learning a second language can broaden career opportunities and help students understand perspectives from other cultures.
ex.zh: 学习第二语言可以拓宽职业机会，并帮助学生理解其他文化的观点。

ext.tip: the second指第二个；a second可指又一个。
senses: Coming immediately after the first in an order.
A unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute.
To formally support a proposal made by someone else.

ex.en: Our flat is on the third floor, beside the lift.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓在三楼，电梯旁边。

ex.en: Approximately one third of the city's residents rely on public transport for their daily commute.
ex.zh: 该市约三分之一的居民依靠公共交通进行日常通勤。

ext.tip: 表示分数：one third；two thirds。
senses: Coming after the second and before the fourth.
One of three equal parts of something.

ex.en: A small wooden shelf hangs above the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 厨房水槽上方挂着一个小木架。

ex.en: Temperatures above the seasonal average can increase water demand and put pressure on urban supplies.
ex.zh: 高于当季平均水平的气温会增加用水需求，给城市供水带来压力。

ext.tip: above 表示位置更高，不一定正上方，也不表示接触。
senses: In a higher position than something else.
Greater than a particular amount, level, or standard.
In a higher place or earlier in a piece of writing.

ex.en: Our apartment building has a garden on the roof.
ex.zh: 我们住的公寓楼屋顶上有一个花园。

ext.tip: 指建筑物时可数，指建造活动时通常不可数。
senses: a structure with walls and a roof
the activity of constructing houses or other structures

ex.en: We explored the city on foot all afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在步行游览这座城市。

ex.en: A well-designed city provides accessible public transport and green spaces that improve residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 一座规划良好的城市会提供便利的公共交通和绿地，改善居民的生活质量。

ext.tip: 复数为cities；市中心英式用city centre。
senses: A large town where many people live and work.

ex.en: We bought fresh eggs from a nearby farm.
ex.zh: 我们从附近的农场买了新鲜鸡蛋。

ex.en: Small farms can support local food supplies while creating employment opportunities in rural communities.
ex.zh: 小型农场既能支持当地食品供应，也能为农村社区创造就业机会。

ext.tip: 表示在农场通常用on a farm，不用in。
senses: land and buildings used for growing crops or raising animals
to grow crops or raise animals for food or other products

ex.en: We spread the map across the table before leaving.
ex.zh: 出发前，我们把地图铺在桌上。

ex.en: Researchers use satellite images to map changes in forest cover and identify areas needing urgent protection.
ex.zh: 研究人员利用卫星图像绘制森林覆盖变化图，并确定急需保护的区域。

ext.tip: map作动词时，过去式mapped，分词mapping。
senses: A drawing showing where places or features are located
To draw or record the position of places or features

ex.en: We bought fresh peaches at the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我们在集市买了新鲜桃子。

ex.en: Companies increasingly market environmentally friendly products to consumers who want to reduce their impact on the planet.
ex.zh: 企业越来越多地向希望减轻自身环境影响的消费者推销环保产品。

ext.tip: a market for sth指对某物的市场需求。
senses: a place where people buy and sell goods
the demand for something or the business of trading particular goods
to promote and offer a product for sale

ex.en: We found a quiet café near the station.
ex.zh: 我们在车站附近找到了一家安静的咖啡馆。

ex.en: Building affordable housing near public transport can reduce commuting costs and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 在公共交通设施附近建设经济适用住房，可以降低通勤成本并增加就业机会。

ext.tip: near可直接接地点；nearly通常表示“几乎”。
senses: close to a place, time, or state
at or towards a short distance away in space or time
not far away in distance or time

ex.en: A small bird flew over the garden wall.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟飞过了花园的围墙。

ex.en: Over half of the residents surveyed supported plans to create more green spaces in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 受访居民中有超过一半支持在社区内增设绿地的计划。

ext.tip: over可指越过或超过；be over表示结束。
senses: above something or from one side to the other
more than a particular amount, age, or level

ex.en: This shady spot is a lovely place for a picnic.
ex.zh: 这处阴凉的地方很适合野餐。

ex.en: Urban planners should place public facilities near residential areas to make essential services accessible to everyone.
ex.zh: 城市规划者应将公共设施设在住宅区附近，让所有人都能方便地获得基本服务。

ext.tip: take place表示发生或举行，不用被动语态。
senses: A particular area, position, or location.
To put something in a particular position.
A space available for someone to sit, study, or participate.

ex.en: Fold the paper into a square before cutting it.
ex.zh: 先把纸折成正方形，再剪。

ex.en: Creating a public square can encourage social interaction and provide space for cultural events in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在拥挤的城市中，建设公共广场可以促进社交互动，并为文化活动提供空间。

ext.tip: 面积用square metres；长度用metres，勿混淆。
senses: a shape with four equal sides and four right angles
an open public area surrounded by buildings
shaped like a square, or expressing area in squared units

ex.en: We hurried to the station with our heavy suitcases.
ex.zh: 我们提着沉重的行李箱匆忙赶往车站。

ex.en: Local authorities should station trained staff at busy transport hubs to assist passengers with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 地方政府应在繁忙的交通枢纽安排受过培训的工作人员，帮助行动不便的乘客。

ext.tip: 作动词常用被动式be stationed at，表示被派驻。
senses: A place where trains or buses stop for passengers.
A place or organisation providing a particular service.
To place someone somewhere to perform a duty.

ex.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
ex.zh: 用尺子画一条直线。

ex.en: Building straight roads across mountainous regions can be expensive and may damage natural habitats.
ex.zh: 在山区修建笔直的道路可能成本高昂，还可能破坏自然栖息地。

ext.tip: straight本身可作副词，不用加-ly。
senses: honest and clear rather than hiding the truth

ex.en: Our town has a bakery beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们镇的老桥旁有一家面包店。

ex.en: Improving public transport in a small town can help residents access jobs and essential services.
ex.zh: 改善小城镇的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会和基本服务。

ext.tip: go into town指去市中心，此时town前不加冠词。
senses: A settlement usually larger than a village but smaller than a city
The central area where people go shopping or do business

ex.en: Show me an easier way to fold this sheet.
ex.zh: 教我一个更简单的叠床单方法吧。

ex.en: Improving public transport is an effective way to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通是减少交通拥堵和城市空气污染的有效方法。

ext.tip: “做某事的方法”可用way to do或way of doing。
senses: A route or direction leading somewhere.
By a large amount or distance.

ex.en: Be careful not to break that glass bowl.
ex.zh: 小心别打碎那个玻璃碗。

ex.en: Regular breaks during study sessions may improve concentration and help students retain new information.
ex.zh: 学习期间定时休息可能有助于提高注意力，并帮助学生记住新知识。

ext.tip: 动词变化为break—broke—broken；休息用take a break。
senses: To separate into pieces or damage something so it stops working.
A short period when an activity stops.
To fail to obey a rule or keep a promise.

ex.en: I took your umbrella by mistake this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我误拿了你的伞。

ex.en: Teachers should encourage students to learn from mistakes rather than feel ashamed of making them.
ex.zh: 教师应鼓励学生从错误中学习，而不是因为犯错而感到羞愧。

ext.tip: 说make a mistake，不说do；动词过去式为mistook。
senses: Something incorrect that you do, say, or believe.
To wrongly identify someone or understand something incorrectly.

ex.en: A student left her backpack under the library desk.
ex.zh: 一名学生把背包落在了图书馆的书桌下面。

ex.en: Universities should ensure that every student can access affordable housing and appropriate support throughout their studies.
ex.zh: 大学应确保每位学生在整个求学期间都能获得负担得起的住宿及适当支持。

ext.tip: student不限于大学生；pupil主要指中小学生。
senses: a person who studies at a school, college, or university

ex.en: I study English on the bus every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上在公交车上学英语。

ex.en: A recent study suggests that regular exercise can improve students' concentration during classroom activities.
ex.zh: 最近一项研究表明，经常锻炼能提高学生在课堂活动中的专注力。

ext.tip: study强调学习过程，learn常强调学会或获得知识。
senses: Spend time learning about or carefully examining a subject.
The activity of learning, or an investigation of a subject.
A room used for reading, writing, or working.

ex.en: My aunt taught me how to mend a shirt.
ex.zh: 姑姑教会了我如何缝补衬衫。

ext.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为taught；教某人做用teach sb to do。
senses: Help someone learn knowledge, skills, or ways of behaving

ex.en: My sister plays the drums in a local band.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在当地一支乐队里打鼓。

ex.en: Live bands at community festivals can attract visitors and create opportunities for local businesses.
ex.zh: 社区节庆中的现场乐队演出能吸引游客，并为当地商家创造机会。

ext.tip: IELTS中的band指成绩等级，不是乐队。
senses: A group of musicians who perform together.
A narrow strip or ring of material or colour.
A range of frequencies, values, or levels within a system.

ex.en: We danced in the kitchen while dinner was cooking.
ex.zh: 晚饭还在做的时候，我们在厨房里跳起了舞。

ex.en: Traditional dance can strengthen community identity while offering younger generations a connection to their cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 传统舞蹈能够增强社区认同感，同时让年轻一代与自身文化遗产建立联系。

ext.tip: 随音乐跳舞用dance to music，介词用to。
senses: to move your body rhythmically, usually to music
rhythmic movement to music, or an event for dancing

ex.en: We watched a funny film after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。

ex.en: Documentary films can raise public awareness of environmental problems by showing their effects on local communities.
ex.zh: 纪录片可以通过展示环境问题对当地社区的影响，提高公众的环保意识。

ext.tip: 表示电影时，film偏英式，movie偏美式。
senses: a story or events recorded as moving pictures
to record moving pictures using a camera
a thin layer, or material used to record photographs

ex.en: We watched a funny movie after dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。

ex.en: Movies can introduce audiences to unfamiliar cultures, although they sometimes reinforce stereotypes rather than challenge them.
ex.zh: 电影可以向观众介绍陌生文化，不过有时也会强化刻板印象，而非打破它们。

ext.tip: movie偏美式，英式常用film；the movies可指电影院。
senses: a recorded story or sequence of moving images for watching

ex.en: We held a small party in the garden yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在花园里办了一场小聚会。

ex.en: Each political party should explain how its education policies will benefit students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
ex.zh: 每个政党都应说明其教育政策将如何惠及弱势背景的学生。

ext.tip: 合同中的party指当事方，不是聚会或政党。
senses: A social gathering where people celebrate or enjoy themselves.
An organised group seeking political power through shared policies.
A person or group involved in an agreement or dispute.

ex.en: We spent the afternoon swimming in the outdoor pool.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在室外游泳池游泳。

ex.en: Small businesses can pool their resources to purchase equipment that would otherwise be too expensive.
ex.zh: 小企业可以集中资源，购买单独承担会过于昂贵的设备。

ext.tip: pool resources指集中资源；play pool则指打美式台球。
senses: An artificial swimming basin or a small area of still water
A supply of money, people, or resources available for shared use
To combine resources so people can use them together

ex.en: Daily practice helped me play the guitar more confidently.
ex.zh: 每天练习让我弹吉他时更加自信。

ex.en: Schools should give students opportunities to put scientific knowledge into practice through experiments and practical projects.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生有机会通过实验和实践项目，将科学知识付诸应用。

ext.tip: 英式名词用practice，动词用practise；美式均用practice。
senses: Repeated activity done to improve a skill.
A usual or established way of doing something.
The actual use of an idea, method, or skill.

ex.en: All the children were present for the class photo.
ex.zh: 拍班级合照时，所有孩子都在场。

ex.en: Researchers should present their findings clearly so that policymakers can make informed decisions about public health.
ex.zh: 研究人员应清楚地展示研究结果，以便政策制定者就公共卫生作出有依据的决策。

ext.tip: 名词、形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。
senses: being in a place; existing or happening now
to show, explain or formally give something
something given to someone; the time happening now

ex.en: We watched a video of penguins sliding across ice.
ex.zh: 我们看了一段企鹅在冰上滑行的视频。

ex.en: Educational video can make complex processes easier to understand, especially for students with limited background knowledge.
ex.zh: 教学视频可以让复杂的过程更容易理解，对背景知识有限的学生尤其如此。

ext.tip: 一段视频用a video；泛指视频媒介时可不可数。
senses: A recording of moving images, usually with sound.
Record moving images of someone or something.

ex.en: We usually take a short walk after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们通常在晚饭后散一小会儿步。

ex.en: After cities improve public transport, more residents may choose to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 城市改善公共交通后，更多居民可能会选择不开车出门。

ext.tip: 介词后接名词或动名词；连词后接完整从句。
senses: later than an event or time
following the time when something happens
behind or following someone or something

ex.en: My neighbour always waves when she sees me.
ex.zh: 我的邻居每次看见我都会挥手。

ex.en: Higher levels of economic growth do not always lead to better living conditions for every citizen.
ex.zh: 更高水平的经济增长并不总能让每位公民的生活条件得到改善。

ext.tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；not always是并非总是。
senses: every time or on every occasion
throughout all time or for ever

ex.en: Please put your shoes by the door before dinner.
ex.zh: 请在晚饭前把鞋放到门边。

ex.en: Before introducing new transport policies, local authorities should consult residents about their daily travel needs.
ex.zh: 地方政府在推出新的交通政策之前，应就居民的日常出行需求征求意见。

ext.tip: 时间从句表将来时，before后通常用一般现在时。
senses: Earlier than a particular time or event.
Earlier than the time when something happens.

ex.en: Every child brought a favourite toy to the picnic.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都带了一件最喜欢的玩具去野餐。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that every student has access to reliable internet services for learning.
ex.zh: 政府应确保每个学生都能使用可靠的互联网服务进行学习。

ext.tip: every后通常接单数可数名词，谓语也用单数。
